text: OVERDOSAGE No overdosage with ribavirin for inhalation solution, USP by aerosol administration has been reported in humans. The LD 50 in mice is 2 g orally and is associated with hypoactivity and gastrointestinal symptoms (estimated human equivalent dose of 0.17 g/kg, based on body surface area conversion). The mean plasma half-life after administration of aerosolized ribavirin for inhalation solution, USP for pediatric patients is 9.5 hours. ribavirin for inhalation solution, USP is concentrated and persists in red blood cells for the life of the erythrocyte (see Pharmacokinetics ).
